capabilities: Render a folder of Markdown manuscripts as a 3D bookshelf with cover images
Open a book's entry page from the shelf
Create and save .library index files via forms and context menus
Override discovered book title, description, cover, and entry through an edit form
Configure theme, rendering quality, motion, and an accessible cover-list fallback
extras: Fully offline and self-contained: no accounts, telemetry, or runtime network requests. 1.0.0 is described as the initial release candidate, with roadmap and release-gate documents referenced elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no visual, book-like way to browse a folder of related Markdown documents; folders show as plain file lists.
summary: 3D bookshelf viewer that renders a folder of Markdown manuscripts as an interactive Three.js shelf with covers, search, and book-opening animations.
